scope: fresh generation sample, not full official pool construction or final product throughput
environment: Node 22 / Vitest 5 with offline dependencies; sequential performance.now elapsed milliseconds, no process.cpuUsage measurements
samplingRule: For takuzu/hitofude/tsume/reflection/parking/water/slide: first n accepted pool condition records per level, fresh deterministic candidate seed. For ice: first official difficulty pattern per level, five new seeds, bounded iterations.
caveats: Selected conditions are conditional on prior accepted pools, not random selection across generator profiles. Rates cannot be generalized to each level or the full product.

Generation-only timings are not an end-to-end cost. In particular water-sort excludes natural-play 60-trial screening; slide board generation excludes pattern DB setup and optimal-count search; ice includes a bounded generator search, not a production pool scheduling run.
The measured times are sequential elapsed wall-time, not CPU seconds. No new selection logic was shipped.
Samples are small for several computationally expensive generators, so p90 values have high sampling error.

measurements.measures: generation plus best-of-eight orientation difficulty assessment
generation including bounded failures plus exact difficulty analysis
generation plus human-oriented difficulty classification with known solution
board scramble generation only, millisecond precision rounds most timings to zero
candidate generation with optimal-solution search, maxAttempts 10; excludes 60-run natural-play classification
candidate generation with built-in difficulty analysis; maxAttempts 10
bounded level-specific first recipe, tactic search 2000 iterations or element search 3000; no-candidate is a bounded selection result, not an exception

slidePuzzleExactCounter.method: createSlidePuzzleOptimalMoveCounter, pattern database initialization once per dimension; then generate board and find shortest solution with bounded IDA*
slidePuzzleExactCounter.caution: Size 5 pattern database initialization was ~179 seconds for this process. It is setup per counter instantiation, not per puzzle; warm per-problem times are very small on these shallow sample boards and cannot be extrapolated to all 5x5 difficulty levels.
